entities.name: Ryan Romano
entities.summary: Protagonist courier codenamed Quicksave; a Violet Genome time-looper who sets a save point, dies, and reloads. Bored immortal seeking his lost friend Len.

facts.value: Runs Quicksave Deliveries
Wears mouthless metal mask, top hat, navy trench coat
Time-stop turns the world purple and silent
Most powers need a conscious action to trigger
Drives a customized red Plymouth Fury reinforced for ramming
Owns a white rabbit plushie he calls his most devastating weapon
Motto: I'm immortal but don't tell anyone

ties.rel: defeated and delivered to Private Security

questions: What exactly is the full scope of his save/reload power?

entities.name: Len
entities.summary: Ryan's lost best friend, a brilliant tinkerer he has hunted for years. Black hair, blue eyes, committed Marxist-Leninist.

facts.value: Made Ryan's boxers years ago
Rumored to be in New Rome

entities.name: Renesco
entities.summary: Balding old Italian barman of the Jolie Wrangler, an Augusti front bar; receives Ryan's briefcase delivery.

facts.value: Owns the Jolie Wrangler pub
Pays Private Security a protection subscription

entities.name: Ghoul
entities.summary: Skeletal ice-Genome Psycho of the Meta-Gang who kills Ryan and Renesco in an early loop, sent by Adam.

facts.value: Skinless skeleton exhaling chilling mist that forms ice weapons
Manifests ice armor over his bones
Sent by Adam
Second power is immortality, survives dismemberment and organ loss
Can transform into a giant ice-and-snow titan
Locates enemies by temperature when blinded

entities.name: New Rome
entities.summary: Largest metropolis in Italy and ravaged Europe's capital of sin, built on the gulf of Naples after Mechron bombed the old city; corporate-run, 'no gods nor kings, only money'.

facts.value: Built on the ruins of Naples
Dominated by the Dynamis corporation
Districts include the Golden Coast, Rust Town, the Plebeian district and Little Maghreb

entities.name: Dynamis
entities.summary: The megacorporation that openly runs New Rome, marked by an ouroboros logo; sells Genome elixirs and owns the Il Migliore hero team.

facts.value: Sells the Hercules Elixir for 100k euros
Ouroboros corporate symbol
Owns Il Migliore's image and merchandising

entities.name: Meta-Gang
entities.summary: Roving band of Psycho elixir-junkies led by Adam, hitting Augusti fronts across New Rome.

facts.value: Members are Psychos (multi-elixir mutants)
Led by Adam who reportedly eats people

entities.name: The Augusti
entities.summary: The true criminal power in New Rome and most of Italy, led by the invincible Augustus; styles itself a family of honorable men.

facts.value: Led by Augustus
Renesco's bar is one of its fronts

entities.name: Private Security
entities.summary: Dynamis's armed enforcers, openly bribable, running subscription protection rackets.

facts.value: Wear Dynamis ouroboros gear and carry energy rifles
Grunts are easily bribed

entities.name: Adam
entities.summary: Boss of the Meta-Gang; reputedly eats people. Orders the hit on Renesco.

facts.value: Leader of the Meta-Gang
Said to eat people

entities.name: Genome
entities.summary: A superpowered human created by drinking an Elixir; gains a power plus enhanced physique. Taking two or more elixirs makes an unstable, addicted Psycho.

facts.value: Powers come from colored Elixirs
Psychos are multi-elixir mutants who need periodic injections

entities.name: Genome Wars
entities.summary: The past cataclysm that ravaged Europe and destroyed the old world after Elixirs appeared; Mechron's drones bombed Naples to ruins.

facts.value: Devastated southern Europe
Mechron's drones destroyed the old Naples

entities.name: Jolie Wrangler
entities.summary: Renesco's cozy pub, an Augusti front where Ryan makes his fatal briefcase delivery.

entities.name: Wyvern
entities.summary: Star superheroine of Il Migliore; an amazonian woman with translucent dragonfly wings, near-silent supersonic flight and super strength. Tries to recruit Ryan and offers to help find Len.

facts.value: Black shoulder-length hair, greyish eyes, white Dynamis bodysuit
Translucent dragonfly wings, silent near-supersonic flight
Can bench press a school bus even partially transformed
Wears an earplug comm and takes orders mid-conversation

entities.name: Il Migliore
entities.summary: Dynamis's corporate superhero team, official celebrity protectors of New Rome, contrasted with the pro-bono Carnival.

facts.value: On Dynamis's payroll
Brands the Augusti as supervillains

entities.name: Vulcan
entities.summary: Encrypted-voice representative of the Augusti who counter-recruits Ryan, summoning him to the Bakuto casino; oversees the Augusti weapons/tech division.

facts.value: Speaks only through an encrypted voice channel
Offers Ryan women, weapons and Bliss to prove himself

entities.name: Augustus
entities.summary: Self-styled emperor of Italy and head of the Augusti; invincible and able to shoot homing lightning, with more victims to his name than the cigarette.

facts.value: Invincible and shoots homing lightning
One of the rare two-power Genomes with no ill effects

entities.name: Leo Hargraves
entities.summary: Leader of the Carnival, the pro-bono wandering-knight heroes Ryan admires despite them causing the worst day of his life.

entities.name: The Carnival
entities.summary: Leo Hargraves's band of real pro-bono, wandering-knight superheroes, unlike the corporate Il Migliore.

facts.value: Pro-bono heroes, not corporate sellouts

entities.name: Rust Town
entities.summary: New Rome's walled-off poor northwest industrial district, a polluted labyrinth where rogue Geniuses trade; where Ryan hunts for leads on Len.

facts.value: Walled off from the rest of the city
Home to the Junkyard black market

entities.name: The Junkyard
entities.summary: An old coal mine turned open landfill in Rust Town where rogue Geniuses and adventurers trade Genius tech; full of cutthroats and Psychos.

entities.name: Bakuto
entities.summary: Japan-themed Augusti casino where Vulcan summons Ryan; pagoda architecture, samurai bouncers, pachinko and sumo.

entities.name: Bliss
entities.summary: The ubiquitous mushroom drug of New Rome, peddled openly to the poor.

entities.name: Zanbato
entities.summary: Augusti Genome and Ryan's handler; wears sleek blue samurai armor with a demon-mask helm and conjures a crimson solid-light katana. A true believer who calls the Augusti honorable men; his real name is Jamie Cutter.

facts.value: Conjures a crimson solid-light katana
Wears blue skintight samurai power armor
Italian, with a Korean girlfriend he hopes to marry
One of the Augusti's primary recruiters

entities.name: Luigi
entities.summary: Augusti supply manager alias Crypto; a fashionable African-Italian barely eighteen with a truth-compulsion power that stops anyone from lying once they start talking to him.

facts.value: Alias Crypto
Truth-compulsion power once you start talking
Manages Augusti supply runs

entities.name: Sarin
entities.summary: Meta-Gang Psycho in a black hazmat suit whose gauntlets fire compressed-air blasts; her true body is a corrosive gas that rusts metal. Ryan nicknames her Blower.

facts.value: Fires compressed-air shockwaves and self-propels
Her body is corrosive gas that rusts metal
Wears a black hazmat suit and gas mask

entities.name: The Fisty Brothers
entities.summary: Ryan's signature pisto-gauntlets: hydraulic piston-ram gloves (Mechron design) that he upgraded with an electric shock. He jokes they are the real A-bombs; they jam when frozen by Ghoul's mist.

facts.value: Piston-powered ram gauntlets with added electric shock
Based on Genius Mechron's close-combat drone design
Jam when iced over

entities.name: Quicksave
entities.summary: Ryan's power set: a Violet time-manipulator who can freeze time up to ten seconds with a cooldown equal to the duration used, plus a hidden save/reload ability he never reveals. Publicly known only for the time-stop.

facts.value: Time-stop up to 10 seconds, cooldown equals time used
Hidden save/reload ('quicksave') never disclosed
Violet Genome (spacetime class)

entities.name: Len's Bathyspheres
entities.summary: Cableless crimson steampunk submersibles powered by small propellers, unmistakably Len's rugged efficient design; the Augusti use them to move supplies underwater from the old harbor. First hard proof Len is in New Rome.

entities.name: Mount Augustus
entities.summary: Augustus's fortified hilltop estate on New Rome's highest point, officially 'Hillside'; a Vatican-sized Roman villa with a Parthenon replica, ringed by kilometers of empty land, a fence, and security. Ryan avoids it.

facts.value: Officially named Hillside
Roman villa the size of the Vatican with a Parthenon replica
Isolated for kilometers with one guarded road

entities.name: Ischia
entities.summary: A toxic ruined island in the local gulf, never renovated after Mechron bombed Italy; Ryan suspects the Augusti bathyspheres ferry supplies there and that Len may be hidden on it.

facts.value: Toxic ruin since Mechron's bombing
Ryan's suspected destination for the bathysphere shipments

entities.name: Mystery Woman in Crimson
entities.summary: An elegant woman with long black hair, a crimson gown, and a beauty spot on her right cheek who sits beside Ryan at the Bakuto and flirtatiously probes him; she reacts with recognition to his money-fan stunt. Identity unknown.

facts.value: Long black hair, crimson gown, beauty spot on right cheek
Approaches Ryan at the Bakuto and probes him
Shows a flash of recognition at his behavior

entities.name: Little Maghreb
entities.summary: The Arab quarter of New Rome's Plebeian district, billboards in Arabic/Turkish, a derelict mosque and a replica Turin synagogue; Ryan hides in a seedy hotel here after his room is firebombed.

plotlines.title: The endless delivery loop
plotlines.summary: Ryan keeps dying delivering a briefcase to Renesco; on the fourth loop he rams the assassin Ghoul with his Plymouth, beats him with a bat, bribes Private Security, and completes the delivery. His only motive: he is bored.

beats.summary: Ryan keeps dying delivering a briefcase to Renesco; on the fourth loop he rams the assassin Ghoul with his Plymouth, beats him with a bat, bribes Private Security, and completes the delivery. His only motive: he is bored.

plotlines.title: Competing recruitment: the branching paths
plotlines.summary: Wyvern of Il Migliore recruits Ryan and offers to help find Len; then Vulcan of the Augusti counter-recruits him to the Bakuto casino. Ryan realizes multiple faction routes have opened, but his true quest is finding Len.

beats.summary: Wyvern of Il Migliore recruits Ryan and offers to help find Len; then Vulcan of the Augusti counter-recruits him to the Bakuto casino. Ryan realizes multiple faction routes have opened, but his true quest is finding Len.

plotlines.title: Joining the Augusti to find Len
plotlines.summary: At the Bakuto, Zanbato recruits Ryan with a favor-for-favor deal: help crush the Meta-Gang and the Augusti will help find Len. Zanbato warns Ghoul has been busted out of Private Security and will hunt Ryan.

beats.summary: At the Bakuto, Zanbato recruits Ryan with a favor-for-favor deal: help crush the Meta-Gang and the Augusti will help find Len. Zanbato warns Ghoul has been busted out of Private Security and will hunt Ryan.

plotlines.title: Harbor ambush and the Len breakthrough
plotlines.summary: Guarding an Augusti supply run at the old harbor, Ryan sees Len's crimson bathyspheres surface and realizes she is truly in New Rome. Ghoul and Sarin (Blower) ambush the shipment; Ryan fights them off solo, learning the Meta answer to a leader named Adam.

beats.summary: Guarding an Augusti supply run at the old harbor, Ryan sees Len's crimson bathyspheres surface and realizes she is truly in New Rome. Ghoul and Sarin (Blower) ambush the shipment; Ryan fights them off solo, learning the Meta answer to a leader named Adam.

plotlines.title: Battle won, then killed in the night
plotlines.summary: With Zanbato's help Ryan defeats Ghoul and Sarin as Private Security fires on everyone; Zanbato reveals his real name is Jamie and promises to ask Vulcan about Len's tech. Back at his hotel, Ryan is killed by a firebomb rigged to his door, forcing a reload.

beats.summary: With Zanbato's help Ryan defeats Ghoul and Sarin as Private Security fires on everyone; Zanbato reveals his real name is Jamie and promises to ask Vulcan about Len's tech. Back at his hotel, Ryan is killed by a firebomb rigged to his door, forcing a reload.

plotlines.title: The divergence that breaks the Augusti path
plotlines.summary: Reloading, Ryan changes his routine (shoots Ghoul, switches hotels, warns Wyvern). The changes cost him: Vulcan never calls, the Augusti path closes, and he meets the mysterious crimson-gowned woman at the Bakuto. He resolves to chase Len's tech through Rust Town's black market instead.
